name: board_t5s3
description: Who this firmware is for: the LilyGO T5 E-Paper S3 Pro (H752-01), ESP32-S3-WROOM-1, 16 MB of flash, 8 MB of OPI PSRAM, the ED047TC1 of 4.7 inches driven in parallel and the pin map of the board. Headers only: board/identity.h says the name, board/impl.h says what to link.
